payload.summary: Memory is built after each call by the extractMemories BullMQ job, never on the live turn path
details: src/memory splits a pure core (extractMemories: one callModel call, no DB; reused by the eval harness) from loadExtractionInput and applyExtraction (DB)
The job skips conversations with extractedAt set and marks calls with fewer than 2 user turns as extracted without calling the model

applyExtraction filters model-returned memory and follow-up ids to ones the user owns, caps follow-ups at 3, and writes everything in one transaction (memories, supersededAt, resolvedAt, follow_ups, conversation summary and extractedAt, users.nextOpener)
Array size limits are not expressed in the valibot schema because strict structured outputs reject them; caps are applied in code
The extraction prompt forbids inferring sensitive traits or gender
caveats: Two calls from the same user ending close together can extract concurrently (worker concurrency 5) and race on nextOpener; accepted for a demo
